content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan face significant hurdles when trying to sell their products online due to platform restrictions from Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad. The absence of these services in certain regions necessitates an alternative, sovereign commerce infrastructure that can bypass these restrictions.

Traditional platforms like Gumroad and Stripe offer straightforward ways to sell digital products, but their geographical restrictions and fees can be prohibitive. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as that provided by COREMERCH, offers a suite of tools including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing, all designed to be accessible and affordable for creators worldwide, regardless of their location.

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad exclude specific countries due to regulatory, risk, or compliance issues. This leaves a significant gap for digital creators in these regions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to be inclusive, utilizing cryptocurrencies and decentralized technologies to bypass traditional banking and regulatory hurdles, thereby providing a viable alternative for creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction. It monitors the blockchain in real time. When payment confirms on-chain, it fires a webhook to your configured endpoint automatically. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures creators own their data and customer relationships.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the emphasis on ownership and automation. Creators maintain full control over their digital products and customer data, and the use of automated tools for delivery ensures that products are instantly available to customers upon payment confirmation. This not only enhances the customer experience but also reduces the administrative burden on creators.
